reactions.scope: Production damage and reaction physics: 41 types x six hit sources, all 41 KO blink/cleanup states; native render captures; boundary, shield and pause/orphan pool lifecycle. Bosses and campaign checked separately.

bosses.scope: Production boss AI, all three phases and six regions/difficulties/seats; legal-entry injected heavy damage, real KO progression and earliest reward pickup. Not a human campaign playthrough.

campaign.scope: Diagnostic traversal using legal-entry injected damage; actual contextual use/pickup and objective timers; not a human full campaign playthrough

gameplay.scope: Deterministic combat signatures, tactical damage, air input/physics, curated world structure; campaign completion is checked separately

render.scope: Actual drawImage visibility toggles for native ordinary and boss KO renderers in all six loaded regions; composed ground captures, stage-pack changes, Chrome/WebKit desktop/portrait and all six production reaction previews. Emulation is not physical device certification.

live.scope: Real keyboard pickup and held-club attack, normal-time launched KO with visible blink states and cleanup; short production clip, not a full human playthrough.

checks: Both native image manifests resolve to local files
Review catalog covers forty-one enemies and six endings

baseline.scope: Accepted six-region game, material destruction, bomb goblin, weather/audio and portrait handheld. Current checks exercise enemy reaction physics, all defeat renderers, wave/corpse lifecycle, boss phases/victory, campaign traversal and actual keyboard combat.

limits: Campaign and boss diagnostics inject legal damage with invulnerable heroes; they are not a full human playthrough.
